about:
# ThirdShinigamiEye
Peek inside any chest in the Basement before opening it!

Say goodbye to wasting keys.

Mod idea by [ggNova](https://www.youtube.com/@ggNova-6262) and [synthwave](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCn_pYDrdkqe87AEmzVVdBnA).

Mod name inspired by the Third Eye game mechanic in Persona 5 Royal and the Shinigami Eyes from Death Note.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
